Culinary philosophy

Start from traditional recipes, choose produce with care, then plate each dish with the precision of fine dining.

Official photograph to come

02

Moroccan inspiration

Spices, slow cooking, almond and orange blossom sweets: Moroccan cuisine offers a remarkably rich repertoire, which the menu explores with restraint.

Official photograph to come

03

Know-how and tradition

Some preparations take hours. That time is part of the recipe, and we respect it.

Official photograph to come

04

The art of hospitality

In Morocco, welcoming guests is a way of honouring them. That sense of hospitality guides our service, from the first word to the last attention.

Official photograph to come

05

The atmosphere

Soft light, natural materials, crafted details: a setting designed so that the meal unfolds without haste.
